blockers.title: B1: renumber-proof identity mechanism is real, but the mandated demolish-and-renumber test still does not exist — every resolve fixture passes by slot-order symmetry
blockers.evidence: crisis.odin: 'b, ok := bundles_slot_for_pair(&state.bundles, ac.bundle_lo, ac.bundle_hi); if !ok { cleared = true }' — the pair identity + per-tick re-resolution are correct. crisis_test.odin: every topology transition demolishes the crisis's OWN bundle (pipes 0,1 @1499) and redraws pairs in the same first-seen order (wides @1500), so the named pair keeps its slot — the stale-slot code would produce the identical stream.
blockers.detail: The mechanism fix (canonical pair + eval-time slot resolution) is verified correct. But no test demolishes a PRECEDING full bundle while the crisis's pair stays live and saturated — the scenario that made the r1 slot-index bug bite (spurious resolve + same-tick re-trigger + mislabeled banner). The mandate closes B1 only on a test that bites; the pin is absent.
blockers.recommended_fix: Add a resolve test: crisis active on pair P (slot 1); demolish a full bundle at slot 0; rebuild renumbers P to slot 0; assert the crisis stays active, the banner/outline still name P, and no spurious resolve/re-trigger fires.

warnings.title: Pool_Exhaustion trigger's eval-time pool check under-fires when deliveries drain the pool after the spawn-shed
warnings.evidence: crisis.odin: 'if len(state.flow.packets) >= int(cat.balance.pool_max_packets) && drop_of_reason_this_tick(state, .Pool_Exhaustion)'. flow.odin: the E22 shed happens at SPAWN (phase 1); phase 5 ('CULL delivered packets') removes deliveries in the same flow_step, before crisis_evaluate runs.
warnings.detail: The drop is admission-time evidence the pool WAS at cap; measuring the pool at eval time (post-cull) makes the trigger miss whenever the network still delivers — the map-wide flaw sheds every other tick and is never named. The pinned test passes only because its fixture has no pipes (zero deliveries, pool stays at cap). Same evidence class the W4 fix already corrected for E9.
warnings.recommended_fix: Trigger on the drop evidence (drop_of_reason_this_tick(.Pool_Exhaustion)) with the eval-time pool check as the anti-flap guard, or measure 'at cap' at admission; add a routed-network pool fixture where deliveries drain post-shed.
